summary: A dropdown to pick one of three milestone date types: FID, Construction Start, or COD.
purpose: Lets a user choose which milestone date to work with.
why: Likely reason: limits choices to the known date fields.
how: Shows a select list with three fixed options and passes the chosen stored name back to the parent.
inputs: The current value and a change handler.
outputs: The chosen stored name, passed to the parent.
risks: The stored names must match the database date fields. Renaming one breaks the link without an error.
debug: If choosing has no effect, check the parent's change handler.
